General: Be at least 10 years old or Grade 5 equivalent
Be an active AJY Society or Pathfinder Club member
Memorize and explain the Pathfinder Pledge and Law
Read The Happy Path or similar Pledge and Law book
Hold a current Book Club Certificate
Spiritual Discovery: Memorize Old Testament books and their five divisions
Hold a current memory gem certificate
Know and explain Psalm 23 or Psalm 46
Serving Others: Complete two community friendship/service activities totaling at least two hours
Demonstrate good citizenship at home and school
Friendship Development: Discuss qualities of a good friend and application of the Golden Rule
Know and explain the national anthem
Nature Study: Earn one nature honor from the official Friend options
Demonstrate water purification and camp shelter building
Outdoor Life: Demonstrate required basic knots and their uses
Demonstrate tent pitching, hiking safety, and fire safety
Lifestyle Enrichment: Complete an Arts and Crafts honor

General: Be at least 11 years old or Grade 6 equivalent
Be an active Pathfinder Club member
Read The Happy Path if not previously read
Hold a current Book Club Certificate and review a book
Spiritual Discovery: Memorize New Testament books and groupings
Study a selected teaching of Jesus
Read Matthew and Mark and memorize selected passages
Serving Others: Spend at least two hours serving someone in the community
Participate in a half-day church or community project
Friendship Development: Discuss respect for different cultures and genders
Health and Fitness: Study harmful effects of tobacco and make a commitment
Outdoor Life: Determine eight directions without a compass
Demonstrate Companion knots and three lashings
Nature Study: Participate in nature games or one-hour nature walk
Keep seven-day Creation nature observation log
Lifestyle Enrichment: Earn an Arts and Crafts honor not previously earned

General: Be at least 12 years old or Grade 7 equivalent
Hold a current Book Club Certificate
Spiritual Discovery: Learn use of a Bible concordance
Read Luke and John and discuss selected passages
Explain salvation through a chosen presentation
Serving Others: Assist at least one community service organization
Participate in at least three church programs
Friendship Development: Discuss peer pressure and decision making
Learn how local government serves the community
Health and Fitness: Complete Explorer health and fitness requirements; consult source
Nature Study: Complete Explorer nature study requirements; consult source
Outdoor Life: Complete Explorer outdoor life requirements; consult source

Prerequisites: Baptized Seventh-day Adventist member in regular standing
At least 16 years old when starting; at least 18 at investiture
Complete child-protection training and applicable Mission/Conference checks
Write one-page report or make a video with mentor on meaning of Master Guide
Complete approved Basic Staff Training workshops: purpose/history, organization, planning, outreach, ceremonies/drill, developmental growth, teaching, medical/risk/child safety
Leadership Identity & Growth: Read Education by Ellen White and write one-page reflection
Read approved Adventist leadership book and complete two sharing activities
Complete spiritual gifts and personality surveys with two-page reflections
Serve as club staff or teach age-group Sabbath School for at least one year, including attendance, honors teaching, and Christian Storytelling honor
Lifestyle Development: Complete an approved physical fitness program or qualifying honor
Earn Basic Water Safety, Camp Safety, Camping Skills I and II, and Temperance honors
Earn three additional honors from official approved list
Hold current First Aid and CPR certificate or equivalent
Spiritual Growth: Study Gospels and Desire of Ages or Encounter Series 1, plus sharing
Keep devotional journal for at least one month
Read Steps to Christ and complete two sharing options
Reflect on each of the 28 Fundamental Beliefs
Teach approved Bible instruction or beliefs course
Study Sanctuary and complete sharing activities
Complete Adventist heritage option and sharing activities
Community Development: Help organize three church fellowship events
Participate in approved community service or outreach initiative
Investiture: Complete under the official program timing and accommodation rules
